name: Spark Keeper
lore: One of Confluence Foundry’s twin otter keepers, wearing the same copper-trimmed engineer uniform as Tide Keeper. A human conductor who once powered the Foundry with Tide Keeper. Lightning marks meet friendly water marks to discharge; shots, fields and specials all participate. An enemy Spark Keeper cannot trigger your marks.

primary.name: Copper Note
primary.description: Fire a lightning note that marks the first foe for 3s. Hitting a friendly water mark triggers discharge.

secondary.name: Relay Circle
secondary.description: Aim a 95-radius electrical field. Pulses once per second for 4s, marking foes. Overlap a friendly water field for extra discharge.

special.name: Thunder Score
special.description: After a 1.35s warning, strike repeated lightning chords from your nearby relay fields to the aim point. Without relays, three notes surround the target instead. Four seconds total; each chord pulse hits a foe only once for 24. Water marks discharge on contact.

passive: Conductor’s Step: Standing in your lightning field grants 20% movement speed for 1.2s, refreshed while inside.

technique.name: Long Refrain
technique.description: Relay lasts 6s instead of 4s, but pulses deal 6 instead of 9 damage. Earned by clearing Confluence Foundry in co-op with Tide Keeper and Spark Keeper.

final_technique.name: Double Overture
final_technique.description: Two successive notes for 20 and 9 damage, but a slower 1s cadence. Both stop on impact.

attack.name: Double Overture
attack.description: Two notes for 20 and 9 damage, each applying lightning marks.
